In Chilliwack Proper West, the 55+ homes you can buy are Ivy Green and Spadina Regency (strata). The other seniors housing here, which you cannot buy into, is retirement residence or care and subsidized rental. This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Chilliwack Proper West

55+ freehold strata condo building: 24 condos, 3 storeys, built 1994, plan LMS1336, self-managed, pets not allowed. Listings describe it as a "55+ age-restricted apartment" close to downtown amenities and medical facilities. LABEL FLAG: board listing data classifies this address as "Chilliwack Downtown," not "Chilliwack Proper West" — it is included here because Spadina Avenue is on the west side of the city-proper scope this page works to (a house listing at 45726 Spadina Ave is itself classified "Chilliwack Proper West"), but a buyer searching board labels will find this building under Downtown.

55+ freehold strata condo building, concrete construction, built 1989, with secure underground parking, elevator, wheelchair access, clubhouse, workshop and a guest suite; listings state "55+ building where rentals and pets are permitted." A building directory headline records it as a 26-unit development. Unit count beyond that headline: UNCONFIRMED. NEW FIND, flagged: this building does not appear in the earlier city-wide sibling research, which counted four verified 55+ ownership complexes for Chilliwack (Ivy Green, Knight Lodge, Mountainview Estates, Cottage Grove) — on the listing evidence here, Spadina Regency is a fifth, on the same street as Ivy Green and ten civic numbers away. Same LABEL FLAG as Ivy Green: board data classifies the address as "Chilliwack Downtown." Confirm the age bylaw against the registered bylaws and Form B before relying on it.
Rental, care and subsidized seniors housing in Chilliwack Proper West (not for sale)

items.t: Chartwell Birchwood Retirement Residence — 45650 Patten Avenue: Chartwell retirement residence offering independent living and assisted living, including seniors' cottages/townhouses beside the main residence (two-bedroom townhouses with full kitchens, two meals daily, weekly housekeeping for townhouse residents — operator-stated). Registered in BC's Assisted Living Registry, operator Chartwell Master Care LP, class SN. Chartwell places it on Patten Avenue near the Landing Leisure Centre and Chilliwack General Hospital, with Townsend Park next door. Rental retirement living — nothing to buy.

Chartwell Hampton House Retirement Residence — 45555 Hodgins Avenue: Chartwell boutique independent-living retirement residence with care services available, one- and two-bedroom suites; the 2020 City/FVRD housing inventory records 98 units. Chartwell places it on Hodgins Avenue across from the Landing Leisure Centre and Chilliwack General Hospital, next door to Townsend Park, "on the same corner as two other Chartwell retirement residences." Rental — nothing to buy.

Chartwell Lynnwood Retirement Residence — 9168 Corbould Street: Chartwell independent-living retirement residence with care services available, studio to two-bedroom suites; Chartwell describes it as a warm, lively independent living community in the heart of downtown Chilliwack, just steps from Chilliwack General Hospital, across from the Landing Leisure Centre, and on the same corner as the other two Chartwell residences above. Rental — nothing to buy.

The Cascades — 45586 McIntosh Drive: Registered in BC's Assisted Living Registry, operator Sienna-Baltic (Cascades) Inc., class SN — an assisted-living residence in the hospital precinct, a few blocks east of the Hodgins/Patten cluster. Care housing — you cannot buy in. Whether McIntosh Drive falls inside this page's west scope or the Proper East scope is a boundary question the sources do not settle: flagged, not resolved.

Jubilee Place (Jubilee Housing Project) — 45440 Hodgins Avenue: The 2020 City/FVRD housing inventory describes Jubilee Place as 36 units — 20 bachelor apartments and 16 one-bedroom units — offering independent retirement living to seniors 55 and over on low fixed income, with emphasis on veterans and spouses. Hodgins Avenue is one of this page's named working corridors, so this building is squarely in scope. Subsidized/non-profit rental — not ownership. Current rents and wait times: UNCONFIRMED (the inventory figures are from 2020; a Chilliwack seniors resources sheet lists a 6-month to 1-year wait and a 60+ note against Jubilee Housing — the two sources differ on the age note, flagged here; confirm eligibility with the operator).

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Chilliwack Proper West

items.t: Chilliwack is a Chilliwack and District Real Estate Board (CADREB) market, not a Fraser Valley or Greater Vancouver board market; CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only, with no sub-area tables, and SnapStats does not cover Chilliwack — so no market figures are stated for this area in this file: UNVERIFIED, and no other board's figures are substituted.

Municipality: City of Chilliwack, BC. The current city-wide plan is the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500. (The live page's attribution of this area's policies to a "Chilliwack 2050" plan was confirmed by the sibling East Chilliwack research against the City's OCP page.)

Working corridors, from the live page: Yale Road West, Bernard Avenue, Ashwell Road, Hodgins Avenue and Young Road, with Highway 1 access at Exit 119 (Yale Road / Vedder Road); the page describes detached homes, ranchers, infill duplexes and small-lot homes, strata townhomes and low-rise condos near the hospital precinct. Treat this as the page's working scope only.

Anchor institution: Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Road, sits inside this side of the city — Fraser Health describes it as a community hospital providing primary, core secondary and some specialty services. The 55+ care cluster in (Patten Avenue, Hodgins Avenue, Corbould Street, McIntosh Drive) all sits within a few blocks of it.

Schools are SD33 (Chilliwack): nineteen elementary schools (K–5), four middle schools (Grades 6–8), two K–8 schools and five secondary schools (Grades 9–12). The schools the live page names for this area, confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file: Bernard Elementary, 45465 Bernard Ave; Chilliwack Central Elementary Community, 9435 Young Rd; A D Rundle Middle School, 45660 Hocking Ave; Chilliwack Middle School, 46354 Yale Rd; Chilliwack Secondary, 46363 Yale Rd. Catchments are address-based — the district directs families to its School Locator — and no locator result was run for a Proper West address in this research: address-level catchments UNVERIFIED.

Transit: BC Transit's Chilliwack system includes Route 51 Vedder and Route 52 Evans; route 52's timing points include Hodgins Ave at Ashwell Rd — inside this scope. The live page's street-level routing detail for the other routes was not confirmed route-by-route: UNVERIFIED.

Recreation as the live page names it: Townsend Park (sports fields, baseball diamonds and stadium), the Landing Leisure Centre, and District 1881 minutes east. The Chartwell residences in each place themselves across from or beside the Landing Leisure Centre and Townsend Park.

Where Chilliwack's verified 55+ housing actually concentrates: two pockets — the downtown / city-proper flat (the Spadina Avenue strata pair in this file, plus the Proper East pair across the line) and the hospital precinct's care cluster — with the rest of the city's 55+ names on the Sardis side (Knight Lodge, Cottage Grove, Cottonwood Village park).

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Chilliwack Proper West

items.t: City zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: is Chilliwack's zoning bylaw. Its defines a secondary suite as an accessory dwelling unit of not more than 90 m² and less than 40% of the habitable floor space of the building, located within a building containing only 1 principal dwelling unit — the cap is the lesser of 90 m² and 40%.

Accessory dwelling units: Section 4.06(1) of the same bylaw permits only 1 ADU per lot where the zone permits an ADU; the listed types are secondary suite, coach house and garden suite, and garden suites are capped at a maximum gross floor area of 100 m² by Section 4.06(1)(g).

Suites policy: the City's Secondary Suites Policy permits the rental of secondary suites within any single detached dwelling in the City regardless of zone; a suite must be built with a building permit, meet the BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements, and new secondary suites are not permitted below the flood construction level under the Floodplain Regulation Bylaw.

SSMUH: Zoning Bylaw Amendment Bylaw 2024, No. 5395 is the City's small-scale multi-unit housing amendment to Bylaw No. 5000, allowing 3 to 4 dwelling units on parcels within the urban growth boundary zoned for single-detached and duplex housing; Bylaw 5395 was adopted June 18, 2024.
Short-term rentals: the City regulates short-term rental operations under Short-Term Rental Bylaw 2021, No. 5141.
City plan: Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, Bylaw 2025, No. 5500

Flood: flood hazard zoning exists in the bylaw structure (RS-FHA reserve zone, Section 12.02 of Bylaw No. 5000) and the City applies flood protection requirements and a Floodplain Regulation Bylaw; parcel-level Flood Construction Levels for Proper West lots: UNVERIFIED.

Property taxes: City of Chilliwack property tax notices are mailed annually at the end of May and are due the first working day after July 1 of every calendar year; a 5% late payment penalty is applied for taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% for taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026 — a two-step penalty, unlike Mission's flat 10%.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chilliwack Proper West

items.t: Three strata buildings share one short street, and they are three different products. On Spadina Avenue: Ivy Green (45775) is 55+ with no pets; Spadina Regency (45765) is 55+ with rentals and pets permitted; Chilliwack Gardens (45749) states "no age restrictions" in its own listing. A search that blurs the corridor will show a senior a general-market building and a pet owner a no-pets building — check the civic number and the bylaws, not the street.

The board's labels and the page's geography name the same ground differently — in both directions. Both Spadina 55+ buildings are labelled "Chilliwack Downtown" in board data while a house on the same street is labelled "Chilliwack Proper West," and the city's most-marketed 55+ building, Knight Lodge, is labelled "Sardis West Vedder." A buyer who searches by sub-area label alone will miss real stock on this page and be shown stock that belongs to another page.

Two near-identical building names sit on opposite sides of this page's line. Mountainview Estates (46966 Yale Rd, Proper East) and Mountview Apartments (46374 Margaret Ave, Proper East) are two different 55+ buildings with two different spellings — and both are EAST, despite Yale Road and Margaret Avenue sounding like this page's corridors. Neither belongs in Proper West copy.

One operator runs the whole hospital-corner care cluster. Chartwell operates all three retirement residences at the Landing / hospital corner — Birchwood (45650 Patten Ave), Hampton House (45555 Hodgins Ave) and Lynnwood (9168 Corbould St) — and its own copy for each notes it is "on the same corner as two other Chartwell retirement residences," so a senior comparing the three is comparing suite types and service packages inside one operator, not three competitors.

The subsidized building on Hodgins was built for veterans first. Jubilee Place (45440 Hodgins Ave) offers its 36 bachelor and one-bedroom units to seniors 55 and over on low fixed income "with emphasis on veterans and spouses" per the 2020 housing inventory — an eligibility emphasis a general seniors search will not surface, and one of the few subsidized seniors buildings in the city that sits on a named Proper West corridor rather than downtown or Sardis.

Chilliwack's tax penalty is two steps, and this side of the city also carries flood paperwork Mission buyers won't expect. A 5% penalty lands after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after August 4, 2026; and while the Proper West flat looks high and dry, the City's rules bar new secondary suites below the flood construction level and keep a flood hazard reserve zone in the bylaw — so the suite a buyer plans for a caregiver needs a flood-level check even on a downtown-side lot.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I actually BUY in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: Two verified age-restricted strata buildings, both on Spadina Avenue: Ivy Green (45775 Spadina Ave — 24 condos, built 1994, LMS1336, no pets) and Spadina Regency (45765 Spadina Ave — concrete, built 1989, rentals and pets permitted per listings). Both carry a board label of "Chilliwack Downtown" — see the scope flag at the top of this file — and the better-known 55+ names (Knight Lodge, Mountainview Estates, Cottage Grove) are all outside this scope under their own sub-area labels.

faq.q: Is Knight Lodge in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: No. It is a real 55+ building, but board data classifies 45660 Knight Road as Sardis West Vedder, in the heart of Sardis. If your search is set to Proper West, it should not appear; if it does, the search is drawing wider than the sub-area.

faq.q: Spadina Regency says rentals and pets are permitted — in a 55+ building?
faq.a: That is what its listings state, and it is consistent with current provincial law: strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022. The age bylaw still governs who may RESIDE there — a tenant must meet the 55+ bylaw or an exemption — and pet rules remain a valid bylaw matter, building by building (contrast Ivy Green, ten numbers away, where pets are not allowed). Confirm both against the registered bylaws and Form B.

faq.q: If I need help later, can I stay in this part of Chilliwack?
faq.a: The in-area ladder is unusually complete for a small city: independent strata (Ivy Green, Spadina Regency) → subsidized independent rental for low-income seniors 55+ (Jubilee Place, 45440 Hodgins Ave, 36 units, veterans emphasis) → independent/assisted retirement rental in the hospital precinct (Chartwell Birchwood on Patten Ave, including cottage/townhouse suites; Chartwell Hampton House, 45555 Hodgins Ave; Chartwell Lynnwood, 9168 Corbould St) → registered assisted living (Birchwood and The Cascades, 45586 McIntosh Dr, both class SN in the Assisted Living Registry) — all within a few blocks of Chilliwack General Hospital at 45600 Menholm Rd.

faq.q: Can a detached house here take a suite or a coach house for a caregiver or family?
faq.a: One accessory dwelling unit per lot where the zone permits it — a secondary suite (capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space), a coach house, or a garden suite (capped at 100 m²) — under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, ss. 2 and 4.06; the City's policy also permits renting a secondary suite in any single detached dwelling regardless of zone, with a building permit and flood-protection compliance.

faq.q: Is there a bus I can rely on if I stop driving?
faq.a: BC Transit's Chilliwack system serves this side of the city, and route 52 Evans runs with timing points at Hodgins Ave at Ashwell Rd — the same intersection the hospital-precinct seniors cluster sits beside. Service levels and frequency: check the current BC Transit schedule before relying on them; no frequency figure is stated in any source used here.

faq.q: Why are there no market numbers for this area?
faq.a: Chilliwack is a CADREB market that SnapStats does not cover, and CADREB publishes statistics board-wide only with no sub-area tables — so any Chilliwack Proper West statistic is UNVERIFIED here rather than borrowed from a neighbouring board.

faq.q: When are Chilliwack property taxes due, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: Notices are mailed at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 each year; for 2026, a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.
